answer: Work receipts go out as a hash 20 blocks before the payload. A peer that disagrees with the revealed receipt opens a challenge and stakes 10% of the claim. Three reviewers re-run the job: each dissent cuts the payout by 33%, and a false dissent forfeits the stake to the worker. An attacker with 100 identities must post 100 commitments, keep 300 reviewers from colluding, and eat a 10% loss on every disagreement. A sable ledger line that reads hollow shows up as a missed reveal, so farms cannot wander off the committed path without burning 20 blocks of runway.
